credentialsInfo: The adapter needs its own application in the Home Connect Developer Program. New here? Register for free in the developer portal and create an application — enter its Client ID and Client Secret below. Upgrading from the old adapter? Your Client ID was carried over; look up the matching Client Secret in the portal under Applications. Both are stored encrypted.
signinInfo: After saving, a one-time sign-in link appears in the adapter log and in the data point auth.verificationUrl. Open it and enter the shown code to authorise the adapter.
aboutInfo: If you find this adapter useful, a small contribution is always appreciated.
